content: DRY enforcement is multi-language: clone detection uses jscpd/PMD CPD/Simian (Type-1/2, ceiling zero), SonarQube/NiCad (Type-3, ceiling 2% LOC). Linting per ecosystem: Biome/ESLint for JS/TS, Roslyn Analyzers for C#, detekt for Kotlin, Ruff/Pylint for Python. Architectural analysis: Knip for JS/TS, ArchUnit for Java/Kotlin, NDepend for C#. The theoretical grounding references Myers 1978 content coupling (strongest coupling form), Martin 1995 instability metric, and empirical clone studies by Roy/Cordy/Koschke 2009 and Kamiya et al. 2002.
